name: airtrust-worker
description: AirTrust Worker - Cloudflare Workers API with Hono + TypeScript

scripts.deploy: bash -lc 'if [[ "${AIRTRUST_ALLOW_WORKER_PROD_DEPLOY:-}" != "YES" ]]; then echo "Production deploy blocked. Use the root deploy runbook or set AIRTRUST_ALLOW_WORKER_PROD_DEPLOY=YES in an approved deploy window." >&2; exit 1; fi; wrangler deploy --env production'
scripts.tail: bash -lc 'if [[ "${AIRTRUST_ALLOW_PROD_TAIL:-}" != "YES" ]]; then echo "Production tail blocked. Set AIRTRUST_ALLOW_PROD_TAIL=YES in an approved ops window." >&2; exit 1; fi; wrangler tail --env production'
scripts.d1:migrate:dev: wrangler d1 execute airtrust-db --env development --file=./migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute airtrust-db --env development --file=./migrations/0002_seed_minimo.sql && wrangler d1 execute airtrust-db --env development --file=./migrations/0003_create_usuarios.sql && wrangler d1 execute airtrust-db --env development --file=./migrations/0004_seed_usuarios.sql
scripts.d1:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 execute airtrust-db --env staging --file=./migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute airtrust-db --env staging --file=./migrations/0002_seed_minimo.sql && wrangler d1 execute airtrust-db --env staging --file=./migrations/0003_create_usuarios.sql && wrangler d1 execute airtrust-db --env staging --file=./migrations/0004_seed_usuarios.sql
scripts.d1:migrate:prod: bash -lc 'echo "Direct production D1 migration is blocked. Use an approved runbook with explicit gates." >&2; exit 1'
scripts.d1:seed:dev: npx -y node@20 node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 execute airtrust-db-dev --env development --file=./seeds/dev-seed.sql
scripts.d1:seed:prod: bash -lc 'echo "Direct production D1 seed is blocked. Use an approved runbook with explicit gates." >&2; exit 1'
scripts.secret:put: bash -lc 'if [[ "${AIRTRUST_ALLOW_SECRET_OPS:-}" != "YES" ]]; then echo "Secret writes are blocked. Set AIRTRUST_ALLOW_SECRET_OPS=YES only in an approved ops window." >&2; exit 1; fi; wrangler secret put'
scripts.secret:list: bash -lc 'if [[ "${AIRTRUST_ALLOW_SECRET_OPS:-}" != "YES" ]]; then echo "Secret listing is blocked. Set AIRTRUST_ALLOW_SECRET_OPS=YES only in an approved ops window." >&2; exit 1; fi; wrangler secret list'

author: AirTrust
